fields.EN: A boy who lived as a prisoner alongside Alice. After meeting the Blood Maidens, he learned that he himself was the one and only Blood Youth and became a companion who fought alongside them. Once timid, after escaping Jail twice, he grew into a strong, kind soul who stays calm even in dire situations and will not hesitate to put himself in harm's way for his companions.
fields.JP:
アリスと共に収容者として暮らしていた少年。血式少女た
ちとの出逢いから自らも唯一の血式少年だと発覚し、共に
戦う仲間となった。気弱だった少年も“２度にわたる”ジェ
イルからの脱獄を果たしたことで窮地にあっても冷静さを
失わず、仲間のためにその身を投げ出すことも厭わない強
く優しい魂の持ち主へと成長した。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young man who grew up in the underground Jail alongside 
Alice. Upon encountering the Blood Maidens, he fulfills his 
role as Blood Youth by leading the group of Blood Maidens to 
stage their grand escape from the infernal prison. 
Overcoming the Jail twice across timelines has hardened him 
beyond his meek personality, and he matures into a bold, 
level-headed leader for his allies. His strength becomes the 
collective's, evident in his kindness and sacrifices.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who had always lived in the same Liberated District as Jack and Alice, but her presence was so faint that no one ever noticed her, leaving her to spend all that time alone. She willingly accepted that solitude and lives surprisingly positively, grinning to herself at the visions she sees when she strikes her matches. She shows affection only toward Charlotte, who noticed her and gave her a name.
fields.JP:
ずっとジャックやアリスと同じ解放地区に暮らしていたが、
そのあまりの存在力の薄さにこれまでずっと他人に認識さ
れず１人で過ごしてきた。本人はそんな孤独を好んで受け
入れており、マッチを擦って幻を見ては１人でニヤニヤす
るなど意外とポジティブに生きている。自分を認識し名前
を与えてくれたシャーロットにだけは、親愛の情を向ける。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl with no presence who was raised in the Liberated 
District and lived there at the same time as Jack and Alice. 
She spends most of her time in solitude. She resides in the 
safety of her mind, lighting her special matches to summon 
phantoms from her imagination. From her loneliness, she has 
cultivated self-reliance and a reserved optimism, preferring 
her own mind over the company of others. The only exception 
to this is Charlotte, her dear friend who named and 
acknowledged her when no one else did in the Liberated 
District. They have a charming, but peculiar, friendship.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN:
A mysterious woman who, like Mary, lived in the same Liberated District as Jack.
For some reason, she knows Jack and the Blood Maidens, and even secrets and truths
known only to them. She knew that she herself was a Blood Maiden, but rather than
join the Dawn, she chose to live quietly in the Liberated District with Mary.
fields.JP:
メアリー同様、ジャックと同じ解放地区で暮らしていた謎
の女性。なぜかジャックや血式少女達のことを知っており、
更に彼らしか知らない秘密や真実も知っている。自ら血式
少女であることは分かっていたが、黎明に参加することよ
りもメアリーと解放地区で影ながら過ごすことを選んでい
た。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A mysterious girl who lived with Mary in the Liberated 
District. For some reason, she seems intimately familiar with 
Jack and the Blood Maidens, aware of secrets only they would 
know. Although she is aware of her identity as a Blood 
Maiden, she chose not to join the Dawn, opting instead to 
live in hiding with Mary. After the vicious Massacre Pink 
attack, she joins Mary and Alice on their quest to find their 
lost friends.

fields.EN: A serious girl who rarely shows her emotions, but is attentive and deeply caring at heart. More than anyone, she cares for Jack, with whom she has always been, and when it comes to him she sometimes shows a maidenly side.
fields.JP:
真面目であまり感情を表に出さないが、面倒見が良く根は
とても思いやりに溢れた少女。ずっと一緒に過ごしてきた
ジャックを一番に思っており、彼のことになると乙女な一
面を見せることも。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A calm, analytical young woman whose concern for her 
friends overshadows her seriousness. Having been friends 
with Jack since childhood, she feels especially close to him, 
often blushing or stammering at the mention of his name.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN:
A girl who lives for her beloved, Ningyohime. Though she tries to play the role of
"Ningyohime's prince," at times her timid and gentle side befitting a girl her age shows
through. Having overcome many hardships in the previous game, she now struggles on
together with her partner Jack.
fields.JP:
最愛のひと＝「人魚姫」のために生きる少女。「人魚姫
の王子様」になりきろうとしながらも、ときおり年相応の
女の子らしい臆病で優しい一面が顔をだす。前作の様々な
困難を乗り越え本作では相棒ジャックと一緒に奮闘する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl with an undying love for her princess, Little Mermaid. 
Although she tries her best to act as Little Mermaid's 
chivalrous "Prince," Otsuu has a timid, girly side. Regretful of 
her heart's desire come to life, she uses Witchcraft to reset 
the world with the help of Jack, who helped despite her being 
a Nightmare at the time.
fields.notes: Little Mermaid → Ningyohime; B13 source-faithful profile restoration

fields.EN:
A devoted, brave girl who puts others' happiness before her own. She and Tsuu have
exchanged marriage vows. In the previous game, she faced her fate together with Tsuu
and Jack, and that is how she came to be here now.
fields.JP:
自分の幸せよりも他人の幸せを優先する一途で健気な少女。
つうとはお互いに夫婦の契りを交わしている。前作で自ら
の運命につうやジャックと共に立ち向かい今ここにいる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A brave, earnest soul who always puts others before herself. 
Little Mermaid is in love with Otsuu, and was saved from 
death thanks to her beloved's wish.
fields.notes: Otsuu → Tsuu; B13 source-faithful profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who worked as an assistant to Haru, the weapons craftsman in the underground Liberated District. Cheerful and fearless, she is liked by everyone, though she can be a little nagging. An ordinary girl with no power to fight, she thinks hard and does everything she can to forge a path forward. She is always worried about Haru, from whom she was separated.
fields.JP:
地下の解放地区で武器製造士ハルの助手をしていた少女。
明るく物怖じしない性格で誰からも好かれるが、小うるさ
いのが玉にキズ。戦う力のない普通の女の子だが、一生懸
命考え行動して道を切り拓いていく。離れ離れになったハ
ルのことを常に気にかけている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl who serves as an apprentice to Haru, the weapons 
maker. She moves into the spotlight for this series 
installment as one of the party leaders. Bright and bold, she 
has a habit of speaking without thinking. She makes up for 
her lack of powers with her quick-thinking and dedication to 
her friends.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl with a mad-scientist streak, so devoted to her intellectual curiosity that her morals are somewhat lacking. Traveling with Jack and the others taught her a certain degree of common sense, but even now her impulses sometimes get the better of her. She often teases Hameln. She suffered grave injuries during Genocide Pink's attack...
fields.JP:
知的好奇心に素直すぎてやや道徳に欠けるマッドサイエン
ティスト気質な少女。ジャックたちと行動を共にしてきた
ことである程度の常識を身につけたものの、それでもしば
しば衝動が抑えきれない行動が顔を出す。ハーメルンをよ
くからかっている。処刑台少女の襲撃の際に重症を負って
しまい…。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Equal parts blunt and intellectual, Gretel is an inquisitive 
scientist who is unafraid to pique her curiosity by any means, 
however brutal her methods may be. Thanks to Jack, she has 
begun to consider more humane methods, but her willingness 
to experiment is an ever-present temptation. She often pokes 
fun at Hameln. In the aftermath of Massacre Pink's ambush, 
she suffers heavy wounds...
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who calls herself the "Demon King." She lived all alone underground, surrounded by Marchen. She has fighting strength befitting her arrogant attitude, but she often trips over her lines or falls flat at crucial moments, so she can never quite shake the air of a small fry. After meeting Jack and the others, she learned what it means to have companions and grew as a person.
fields.JP:
自らを「魔王」と自称する少女。地下でたった１人でメル
ヒェンに囲まれて暮らしていた。尊大な態度に見合った戦
闘力を備えているが、肝心なところでセリフを噛んだりズ
ッコケたりするため小物感が拭いきれない。ジャックたち
と出会い、仲間というものを知り、成長していった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The self-proclaimed Demon King. She was raised alongside 
Marchens underground, evident in her occasional lack of tact 
in social situations. The only thing greater than her combat 
abilities is her ego, but she has a tendency to become 
flustered and stumble over her words in passionate moments. 
She credits Jack and the other Blood Maidens for helping her 
acclimate into society.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN:
The youngest member of Genocide Pink, the group that ravages the surface. No matter who she is
dealing with, she is selfish, cheeky, and puts on a brave front. Her formal name is
"Hiaburibashira," but she is called "Shira." Though she is a member of Genocide Pink,
she hesitates to hurt others, for which the other members reprimand and mock her.
fields.JP:
地上を蹂躙する処刑台少女の末妹。どんな相手でもわがま
まで生意気で強がり。正式な名前は「火あぶり柱」だが
"シラ"と呼ばれている。処刑台少女でありながら相手を傷
つけることをためらっており、それを他の処刑台少女達に
叱責・馬鹿にされている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Known to some as "Pi," she is the youngest member of 
Massacre Pink, a murderous girl gang that rules the surface. 
She is petulant and inexperienced, leading her to 
overcompensate with a bratty attitude when frustrated. In 
truth, she has no taste for murder, and feels sympathy for 
those affected by Massacre Pink's violent rampages, much to 
the chagrin of her sisters.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; Pi → Shira; B13 source-faithful profile restoration

fields.EN: A very pure, endlessly cheerful girl. Thanks to Jack and the others, she is gradually learning about human society, though she still often behaves in unconventional ways. Even so, she has learned to value her companions and, above all, no longer treats them as emergency food.
fields.JP:
とても純粋で、底抜けに明るい少女。ジャックたちのおか
げで人間社会を少しずつ学んでいるが、まだまだ非常識な
行動も多い。とはいえ仲間を大事にするようになり、なに
より非常食扱いすることはなくなった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A pure, bright-hearted girl. With Jack's help, her people skills 
have improved, but she has a goofy slip-up from time to time. 
She enjoys supporting her friends in battle with her 
impressive strength, and has finally learned not to treat them 
like tasty morsels.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The youngest of three sisters, she is quiet and rarely shows her emotions. She speaks little and can seem hard to read, but she is more tolerant and considerate of others than anyone. She was anxious after being separated from her sisters in Genocide Pink's attack, but seeing Rapunzel and the others who are younger than her, she came to want to protect them just as her sisters had protected her.
fields.JP:
無口で感情をあまり表に出さない３姉妹の末っ子。
口数が少なく掴みどころのない性格に見えるが、誰より
も寛容で他人を思いやる心を持っている。処刑台少女の
襲撃で姉たちとはぐれてしまったことに不安を感じてい
たが、自分よりも幼いラプンツェル達を前に姉たちのよ
うに自分も彼女達を守りたいと思うようになる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The youngest of three sisters, she is a gentle woman of few 
words. At times, her restrained manner of speech can be 
difficult to follow, but she is more thoughtful and 
open-minded than she appears to let on. The separation from 
her friends following Massacre Pink's ambush leaves her 
feeling uneasy, but with the help of Rapunzel and other Blood 
Maidens, she steels herself to find her sisters.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: An amnesiac boy shrouded in mystery. Calm and rational, he can act ruthlessly for the sake of his goal. He acts with only two fragments of memory to guide him: "I have to find my beloved wife," and "I am a Jail Tower and a Blood Youth."
fields.JP:
すべてが謎につつまれた記憶喪失の少年。冷静で合理性
を重視する性格で、目的のためには冷酷にも振る舞える。
「大切な妻を探さなければいけない」「自分は監獄塔で
あり血式少年である」という記憶の断片だけを頼りに行
動している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A calculating amnesiac whose identity is an enigma to all. He 
is a sharp, level-headed scientist with a relentless 
determination to pursue his goals. He awakes with three 
mysterious fragments of memory: a desire to locate his wife, 
his Blood Youth abilities, and a puzzling connection to Jail.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The middle of three sisters, she is honest and kind. Her escape from the underground Jail helped her grow intellectually... though she remains as scatterbrained as ever.
fields.JP:
素直で優しい３姉妹の次女。地下監獄の脱獄を経て理知
的な面の成長を遂げている……が、相変わらずおっちょ
こちょいではある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The middle of three sisters, she is a trustworthy and 
kind-hearted ally. After her escape from Jail, she pines to 
become known for her intellectual side, but first, she'll have 
to undo her reputation as a klutz.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A laid-back girl in Japanese dress. As much of a shut-in as ever, she hates having to move. Through the bonds she formed with her companions while escaping the underground Jail, she became kind enough to listen to what others have to say. Combined with her naturally easygoing nature, this lets her look at things with a clever eye. "Bamboo No. 1," the vehicle kept aloft by her Blood Ability, is still going strong.
fields.JP:
おっとりした雰囲気の和装少女。相変わらずの引きこも
りで動くことが大キライ。地下監獄の脱獄で築いた仲間
との絆から、様々なことへ耳を傾ける優しさを持ち合わ
せるようになった。そのおかげで本来の飄々とした性格
も合わさり、物事をクレバーな目で見れるようになる。
血式能力で浮遊させる乗り物「バンブー１号」は健在。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A mellow Blood Maiden who is often seen in traditional 
Japanese attire. The only thing she dislikes more than 
unnecessary interaction is having to exert energy of any kind. 
After forming a bond with her fellow Blood Maidens following 
their escape from Jail, she begins to welcome in the kindness 
of others more frequently. Her observational wit and aloof 
demeanor make her something of a wisecrack. She rides 
Bamboo One, a flying device which she operates manually.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A muscle-brained girl whose body moves before she thinks. As the oldest, she has led the Blood Maidens as an older-sister figure. Learning that her own father was the mastermind behind Jail cast a dark shadow over her heart. She acts cheerful as usual, but deep down she lacks confidence in herself.
fields.JP:
考えるよりも先に身体が動いてしまう脳筋少女。いちば
ん年上のため、お姉さんとして血式少女たちをまとめて
きた。だが実の父親がジェイルの黒幕だったことは彼女
の心に暗い影を落とした。普段は明るく振る舞いつつも、
内心では自分自身に自信がもてない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A rough and tumble heroine who acts before she thinks. As 
the oldest of the original three Blood Maidens, she's the de 
facto leader. She suffers an internal crisis upon learning of 
her father's hand in Jail's creation. With one foot forward, 
she puts up a cavalier front, but only to hide her lingering 
doubts.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The eldest of three sisters. Though she looks young, she is sensible and dependable. She cannot be honest with Jack, however, and ends up acting prickly toward him. She is deeply worried about her younger sisters, from whom she was separated during Genocide Pink's fierce attack.
fields.JP:
見た目は幼いが常識人でしっかり者の３姉妹の長女。
だがジャックの前では素直になれずツンケンした態度を
とってしまう。処刑台少女の猛攻ではぐれてしまった妹
たちをとても心配している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The eldest of three sisters, she is a Blood Maiden gifted with 
common sense and charisma. She has some unresolved issues 
which can make her incapable of acknowledging her true 
feelings, which occasionally results in her acting coldly 
towards Jack. Since she was separated from her little sisters 
due to the attack of the Massacre Pinks, she has been 
concerned for their safety.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; group name kept singular; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A haughty girl who speaks like a refined young lady. Thanks to Jack, she is less negative and insecure than before, but she still has a habit of getting depressed over all sorts of things. Her dramatic reactions are unchanged.
fields.JP:
高飛車かつお嬢様口調の少女。ジャックのおかげで自分
に自信を持てないネガティブさは減ったものの、何かに
つけて落ち込む癖はいまだ健在である。リアクションの
激しさも相変わらず。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An eloquent, but snobby Blood Maiden who thinks highly of 
herself. With Jack's help, she has learned to embrace herself 
for who she is, but she is prone to entering depressive spells 
when she does not get her way. She still has over-the-top 
reactions to things.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A boy who was in the cell next to Jack when Jack and Alice were imprisoned in the underground Jail. The three supported one another. He may look a little rough around the edges, but he is dependable and cares deeply about his companions. His natural courage and manliness help dispel Jack and the others' anxieties. He and Hikari are childhood friends and are always saying whatever they like to each other.
fields.JP:
ジャックとアリスが地下監獄で投獄されていた時にジャ
ックの隣の牢にいた少年。ジャックやアリスと共にお互
いを支え合っていた。目つきや柄が少し悪そうだが仲間
思いのしっかり者。持ち前の度胸と男気でジャックや仲
間の不安を払拭していく。ヒカリとは幼馴染でお互い常
に好き勝手に言いあっている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young man who was raised in the underground Jail, and 
lived in a cell adjacent to Jack and Alice. His courageous, 
macho attitude is welcome among the group, oftentimes 
providing a source of motivation in perilous times. He works 
at the campground base, assisting the Blood Maidens with 
tasks and protecting camp while they explore. He and Hikari 
are childhood friends, which means they can fight or bicker 
with the best of them, but always together.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who gained angelic powers through Witchcraft. When Jack and Alice were imprisoned in the underground Jail, she was in the cell next to Jack, and the three supported one another. Just by being there, she has a gift for brightening the people around her and cheering them up.
fields.JP:
ウィッチクラフトの力により天使の力を得た少女。ジャ
ックとアリスが地下監獄で投獄されていた時にジャック
の隣の牢におり、ジャックやアリスと共にお互いを支え
合っていた。その場にいるだけで周囲が明るくなるよう
な人々を照らし元気にしてくれる力がある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A charismatic young woman who was raised in the 
underground Jail, in a cell adjacent to Jack and Alice. She 
brightens up any room she enters with her lovely smile. 
Thanks to Witchcraft, she obtained extraordinary, angelic 
powers to protect the people she loves.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: Calm and composed, he is intelligent and highly adaptable, and when trouble strikes he calculates endlessly. Exercise, however, is very much not his forte. He once died for a certain reason, but was revived as a human formed through mimicry, carrying the feelings of the weapons of the first-generation Dawn members. He is Kaede's childhood friend, and she treats him like a child.
fields.JP:
冷静沈着で応用力のある頭の良さがあり、困った時はひ
たすら計算。ただ運動は大分苦手である。以前とある理
由で死んだものの初代黎明メンバーの武器の想いを汲ん
だ擬態化した人間として蘇る。カエデとは幼馴染で子ど
も扱いされている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young researcher who worked as part of the Dawn. He is 
childhood friends with Kaede, who often treats him like a 
child. He, along with others in the group, was resurrected 
from death thanks to the original Dawn members.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: Tomboyish and quick to pick a fight, but with a big-sisterly nature, she supports the Blood Maidens from the shadows. She once died for a certain reason, but was revived as a human formed through mimicry, carrying the feelings of the weapons of the first-generation Dawn members.
fields.JP:
男勝りで喧嘩っ早いがアネゴ肌な性格で、影ながら血式
少女達を支えている。以前とある理由で死んだものの初
代黎明メンバーの武器の想いを汲んだ擬態化した人間と
して蘇る。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl who grew up in the underground Jail. She is a hardened 
spitfire who aids the Blood Maidens from behind the scenes. 
She was killed in a tragic event, but was resurrected thanks 
to the original Dawn members.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN:
Self-centered and eccentric. The first-person pronoun he uses changes with his mood:
ore, boku, watashi, washi, oira, sessha... He casually uses every first-person pronoun
he can think of. He once died for a certain reason, but was revived as a human formed
through mimicry, carrying the feelings of the weapons of the first-generation Dawn
members. He originally belonged to Dawn's manufacturing team.
fields.JP:
自己中心的でエキセントリック。その時の気分で一人称
が変わる。俺・僕・私・ワシ・おいら・拙者……思いつ
く限りの一人称を適当に使う。以前とある理由で死んだ
ものの初代黎明メンバーの武器の想いを汲んだ擬態化し
た人間として蘇る。元々は黎明の製造班に所属していた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A man who was born and raised in Jail itself, he once worked 
as part of the Dawn's arsenal division. At first glance, he may 
appear to be a selfish eccentric, accentuated by his 
chameleonic speech patterns. This occasionally makes him 
difficult to understand, but he is a jovial presence nonetheless.

fields.EN: The spiritual leader of the Order of the Sun, a group that existed in the underground Jail. Having achieved her goal of reaching the surface, she seems somewhat more relaxed, but she remains unchanged in the way her mysterious remarks bewilder those around her.
fields.JP:
地下監獄にあった「タイヨウ」という団体の教祖。地上
に行くという目標を達成したことで、どこか雰囲気が軽
くなったように感じるが、不思議な発言をして人々を翻
弄するところは変わらない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru, known to her followers as Lady Oohime, is a 
mysterious priestess who leads the Order of the Sun, a 
religious cult which worships the sun, viewing it as a symbol 
of liberation from the Jail. Her awe-inspiring presence seems 
to make up for her cryptic way of speaking, but she wields her 
influence for the good of her people.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The deputy leader of the Order of the Sun, which existed in the underground Jail. He is actually Michiru's younger brother and is always worried about her. He used to be calm but intimidating; after reaching the surface, a weight was lifted from his shoulders, and he no longer shows his wariness as openly as before.
fields.JP:
地下監獄にあった「タイヨウ」という団体の副教祖。
実はミチルの弟であり、常にミチルのことを心配してい
る。昔は冷静で威圧感があったが、地上へと行ったこと
で肩の荷が降り、昔ほど警戒心を露わにしなくなる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A proper, but condescending young man who served as the 
second-in-command for the Order of the Sun. He is rarely 
seen away from Lady Oohime, offering his services as her 
counsel, or on rare occasions, as an interpreter for her 
puzzling remarks. While initially Chiaki was very skeptical of 
associating with Professor and the Blood Maidens, after the 
fall of Snark, he sees the Blood Maidens as his allies.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The Dawn's brusque, ill-mannered "weapons craftsman." He is one of the few artisans capable of making the "Blood Weapons" used by the Blood Maidens. Though he treats his apprentice Clara harshly, he cares for her, and the two have a good master-apprentice relationship.
fields.JP:
ぶっきらぼうで態度が悪い黎明の「武器製造士」。血式
少女達が使う"血式武器"を作れる数少ない職人。その弟
子である「くらら」のことは邪険に扱いながらも可愛が
っており、良い師弟関係となっている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A brusque gentleman who doesn't care to mince words, Haru 
served as the Dawn's Blood Weapons specialist. Despite 
being a skilled artisan and blacksmith in his own right, Haru 
is one of the few weapons masters capable of developing 
equipment for Blood Maidens. Clara is his apprentice, and he 
cares about her more than he lets on.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The Dawn's "big sister from the medical team." Because she was so intelligent, she also worked as the Professor's assistant and has deep knowledge of Jail. Learning that someone she respected was the mastermind came as a shock, but part of her had already suspected it. Perhaps because of that regret, she has become more willing than before to act decisively.
fields.JP:
黎明の「救護班のお姉さん」。頭脳明晰だったことで博
士の助手も行っていたためジェイルについての見識が深
い。尊敬していた人物が黒幕だったことはショックでは
あったが、どこか勘づいていた部分もあり、その後悔か
らか以前よりは思い切って行動することが増えた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A studious member of the Dawn who served as its medical 
specialist. Trained under the Professor himself, she is the 
foremost expert on the Jail and the Blood Maidens. Although 
she was shocked to learn she was deceived by the Professor, 
whom she deeply admired, she takes responsibility for her 
role in his heinous acts and pledges to undo the hurt he has 
caused.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: Formerly a gatekeeper who guarded the entrance to the Liberated District for Dawn. His parents were killed by Marchen, and he trains his muscles every day to avenge them. Ever since learning the truth about Dawn's Professor and the Blood Maidens, he has regarded them with a measure of distrust.
fields.JP:
元は黎明にて解放地区の入り口を守っていた門番。過去
に両親をメルヒェンに殺されており、日々その復讐のた
めに筋肉トレーニングを行なっている。黎明の博士や血
式少女の正体を知って以来、どこか不信な目で見ている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A former member of Dawn who worked as a gatekeeper for 
the Liberated District. Don't let his jolly exterior fool you — 
he can turn intimidating at the drop of a hat, which helps in 
his line of duty. He has a deep-seated contempt for Marchens 
and would give his life to exterminate them.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: The Professor's (Snark's) biological younger brother. They were separated when they crash-landed on Earth. Afterward, he studied Jail and Earth on the surface alongside a wise young man with a promising future. But when a gigantic Jail Tower appeared, his days became a constant flight for survival.
fields.JP:
博士（スナーク）の実の弟であり、地球に不時着した際
離れ離れになってしまう。その後は地上で未来ある賢明
な若者と一緒にジェイルや地球について研究する。しか
しその後現れた巨大な監獄塔の出現により、逃げ続ける
日々となってしまう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The younger brother to the Professor (Snark) who was 
separated from him following the crash landing on Earth. He 
made his way researching the Jail on Earth, assisting fellow 
scientists in creating sustainable solutions to the Marchen 
crisis. Once the Devouring Armada Tower emerged, he and 
others went into hiding.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A middle-aged-looking man. One of the few survivors on the surface, he runs into Mary and the others when he is barely hanging on. He has some knowledge of the surface and shares what he knows about the state of the world and how to survive.
fields.JP:
中年のような男性。数少ない地上の生存者で、ギリギリ
の状態の時にメアリー達と鉢合わせる。ある程度地上の
知識を持っており、世界の状況や生きる術を共有してい
く。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A middle-aged gentleman who lives as a nomadic survivor 
on the surface. He encounters Mary and Alice, the latter 
of whom was on the brink of death. His knowledge of the 
surface aids the party during their exploration.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A gentle woman who belongs to the Order of the Sun. Drawn to Michiru, she joined the order and hopes to become a calm, strong-willed woman like her. Deep down, however, she knows that is beyond her. For now, she tries to dream of the sun however much she can and live in a way she will not be ashamed of when the sun finally appears.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団に入信している穏やかな女性。ミチルに魅
せられタイヨウ教団に入り、ミチルのような穏やかで芯
の強い女性になりたいと思っている。しかし内心では本
人はそれが無理だとわかっており、今は少しでもタイヨ
ウを夢見て、タイヨウが出てきたときに恥じないような
生き方をしようと思っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A gentle priestess who is a devout follower of the Order of 
the Sun. She aspires to be as peaceful and grounded as 
Michiru, who first inspired Sukui to join the order. However, 
deep down she knows that it's impossible. Now she is 
focusing on dreaming about the sun as much as possible and 
is living a life where she can stand pround when the sun 
comes up.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A woman who originally did odd jobs for Dawn. She is clumsy and not especially quick to learn, but believing even she can do something, she stubbornly struggles each day to find what she can do. She has terrible timing and often happens to discover things she was not supposed to see.
fields.JP:
元々黎明で雑用をしていた女性。覚えも決して良くはな
い上にドジだが、こんな自分にも何かできると日々でき
ることを見つけては諦め悪く奮闘している。タイミング
の悪い性質があり、見てはいけないものをたまたま発見
してしまうことが多い。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young woman who used to work for Dawn. While she can 
be clumsy and forgetful, she makes up for it with strong inner 
belief and determination in her quest to aid the Blood 
Maidens. She has a tendency to enter rooms during 
inopportune times, leading to awkward snafus.
fields.notes: B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: One of Genocide Pink and effectively their leader. At first glance she is polite, behaving courteously and using honorific speech. Beneath that exterior, however, she is utterly cruel, treats humans as "trash," and shows not a shred of mercy. When she snaps, her words and behavior change completely and she becomes uncontrollable.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女の１人でリーダー格の少女。丁寧な振る舞い
で敬語を扱う、一見して礼儀正しい性格をしている。だ
がその中身は残虐非道で、人間を「ゴミ」扱いし一片の
慈悲も持たない。キレると言動が一変し手が付けられな
くなる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The leader of Massacre Pink, the murderous girl band. She is 
elitist, well-mannered, fiercely devoted to her Master, 
and is known to bark orders at her sisters to keep them in 
line. Her hatred for mankind turns to sadistic revelry when 
given the opportunity to kill.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: One of Genocide Pink. She is obsessed with beauty and, at the same time, takes pleasure in seeing that beauty destroyed. She lives entirely in the moment and has no thoughtfulness whatsoever; as a result, her unrestrained cruelty stands out even among Genocide Pink. When she snaps, her words and behavior change completely and she becomes uncontrollable.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女の１人。美しさにこだわり、同時にその美し
さが壊れることに快楽をおぼえる刹那主義者。言動のす
べてが刹那的であり思慮深さなどは皆無。その分、突き
抜けた残虐性は処刑台少女の中でも群を抜いている。キ
レると言動が一変し手が付けられなくなる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A member of Massacre Pink who is obsessed with beauty and 
the honor of desecrating it herself. Her affinity for the 
ephemeral makes her spontaneous, particularly when it comes 
to finding new victims. Even among her sisters, her cruelty is 
unmatched.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: One of Genocide Pink. At first glance, she speaks and behaves more normally than the others, but inside she is deeply twisted and black-hearted. She switches between two faces, looks down on others, and is constantly devising malicious ways to toy with them. She also has a habit of immediately wanting whatever belongs to someone else. Yet even what she obtains that way quickly bores her, and she casts it aside and kills it.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女の１人。一見他の処刑台少女よりまともな言
動をするが、その心の中はドス黒く歪んでいる。表と裏
の顔を使い分け他者を見下し、常にどう弄ぼうかと悪知
恵を働かせている。また他人のものをすぐ欲しがる癖が
ある。しかしそうやって手に入れたものもすぐに興味を
失い捨てて殺してしまう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A member of Massacre Pink who works to undo the heroes' 
progress with smug glee. While she does not seem as 
outwardly mad as her sisters, she is cunning and two-faced, 
believing that nearly everyone has something worth taking.
fields.notes: Massacre Pink → Genocide Pink; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who lives in the slums of Leichhardt. She and Ellie were alone until Rachel's parents took them in. She is deeply grateful to Rachel's parents and affectionately calls them "Dad" and "Mom." She loves both her biological younger sister Ellie and her adoptive younger sister Rachel.
fields.JP:
ライカードのスラム街に住んでいる少女。エリーと二
人っきりだったところをレイチェルの両親に拾われ暮ら
している。レイチェルの両親には感謝しかなく「お義父
さん」「お義母さん」と慕っている。実の妹のエリーも
義理の妹のレイチェルも大好き。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl raised in the slums of Licard Island. She, along with her
sister Ellie, was adopted by Rachel's parents. She relishes 
her role as the oldest sister and cares deeply for both Ellie 
and Rachel.
fields.notes: ライカード → Leichhardt; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl from Leichhardt. In this ruined world, she steals from people and survives through sheer toughness. She has always regretted a choice she made long ago. Though she tells herself she is still alive for her other younger sister, part of her lives as if she is being punished.
fields.JP:
ライカード出身の少女。この荒廃した世界で人々のモ
ノを盗み、図太く生き抜いている。昔自分がした選択を
ずっと後悔しており、今は生きているのはもう一人の妹
のためと思いつつも、どこか罰を受けていると思い生き
ている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl from Licard Island who lives as a thief on the surface. 
She has thick skin, hardened by years of scavenging on the 
surface. For some reason, she is burdened by penance, but it 
pushes her to remain strong for her sister.
fields.notes: ライカード → Leichhardt; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who lives in the slums of Leichhardt. She is Riley's biological younger sister, but lately she has grown a little jealous, feeling that her older sister dotes only on their adoptive younger sister Rachel. Since she also loves Rachel dearly, though, she always ends up forgiving her.
fields.JP:
ライカードのスラム街に住んでいる少女。ライリーの
実の妹だが、最近は姉が義理妹のレイチェルばかり可愛
がっていると思い少し嫉妬している。ただ自分もレイチ
ェルのことが大好きなので、結局許してしまう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl raised in the slums of Licard Island. She is Riley's 
younger sister by blood. While she is somewhat jealous of 
Riley's tendency to baby their step-sister, Rachel, Ellie's love 
for Rachel transcends that envy.
fields.notes: ライカード → Leichhardt; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl from Leichhardt. In this ruined world, she steals from people and survives through sheer toughness. She is happy about the choice her older sister once made in choosing her, yet hates herself for feeling that way. Now she simply wants to stay by her sister's side.
fields.JP:
ライカード出身の少女。この荒廃した世界で人々のモ
ノを盗み、図太く生き抜いている。昔選んでくれた姉の
選択を嬉しく思いつつも、そんな自分に自己嫌悪してい
る。今はただ姉の近くにいてあげたいと思っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl from Licard Island who lives as a thief on the surface 
alongside her older sister. She can appear guarded, as she 
hides behind a wall of past regrets. Nevertheless, she adores 
her older sister and fights for their survival.
fields.notes: ライカード → Leichhardt; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration

fields.EN: A girl who lives in the slums of Leichhardt. She is so young that she can barely understand the situation around her, but her two adoptive older sisters protect her well. Rachel loves Riley and Ellie very much.
fields.JP:
ライカードのスラム街に住んでいる少女。あまり状況
の判断ができないほど幼いが、義理の姉二人にしっかり
守られている。そんなライリー・エリーがレイチェルは
大好き。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl raised in the slums of Licard Island. She is precocious, 
but is too young to know the gravity of the situation on her 
island. She adores her sisters, Riley and Ellie, tremendously.
fields.notes: ライカード → Leichhardt; B14 full source-faithful character profile restoration
